Independent project

Designing a personal portfolio

I built this site to bring my education, projects and interests together in one place.

I shaped the content and design with AI-assisted development. I wanted someone new to the site to be able to find my educational background, explore a project or read my writing without sorting through everything at once.

Structuring the site

I gave education, work and writing dedicated spaces. The overview pages offer enough context to decide what to read next, and the detail pages give a project or event room for a proper explanation.

Design and review

I revised the typography, images and page layouts across phone, tablet and desktop widths. Reviewing the pages at different sizes helped me spot awkward line breaks and gaps that were easy to miss on a single screen.
